templates.name: avatar + hero object + price promise (dollar figure on a card, badge or in the headline)
avatar + object + 2 to 3 word caps, white then yellow
avatar + night scene + short mixed-case line

channel_findings.constants: The same avatar on 19 of 20: straw hat, long dark beard with no moustache, white shirt, black suspenders. That costume is the brand mark; there is no logo. Heavy caps in white and yellow with a black stroke. Saturated, warm, high contrast.
channel_findings.host_treatment: Generated inside the scene, waist up, face 15 to 20 % of frame width, usually on one side with the hero object on the other. He always points at the object or holds it, and looks at the camera with a stern or surprised face. The hat brim makes a strong shape that reads at small size.
channel_findings.text_rules: Popular: the dollar figure is the loudest thing ($3, $4, $6 = 1 YEAR, $7, $20, $300) and it is often shown twice, once in the headline and once on a card he holds. Latest: 2 to 3 words, white line then yellow line, no number.
channel_findings.popular_vs_latest: Popular 10: 445,000 to 2,200,000 views. Latest 10: 774 to 26,000. In the thumbnails, 8 of the popular 10 carry a dollar figure and only 1 of the latest 10 does; the latest are also plainer (one object, one line). This study cannot separate the thumbnail change from topic and season, and the popular videos have had far longer to collect views.
channel_findings.top3: 1 (2,200,000), 2 (1,900,000), 3 (1,100,000): avatar pointing at one physical object that solves a costly problem; 2 and 3 show the price.
transfer: A fixed costume is the logo for an AI presenter: 19 of 20. For Paul: one outfit on every thumbnail.
He points at or holds the one object the video is about, and looks at the camera: 1, 3, 4, 5, 10, 19, 20.
One number the viewer can check, shown big: 3, 4, 5, 8. For storms: wind speed, minutes of warning, death toll, year.
Face on one side, proof on the other, headline across the top: 3, 4, 5, 8.
The crowded badge-and-starburst look (2, 7) is a savings-niche habit and does not fit a documentary for viewers aged 45 to 75.
channel_findings.weak: 2 and 7: six or more text blocks, nothing reads at small size. 9: no face and three text blocks. 12: gimmick spelling.
